documents.label: Photograph (captured live)
contentRules: The official FAQ specifies a live-photo process
Do not substitute a pre-existing photo where live capture is required
documents.notes: RRB NTPC captures the photo live — there is no photo upload.

documents.label: Signature
contentRules: Not BLOCK, CAPITAL or disjoined letters
Signature centred in the 35×20 mm scan box
documents.notes: Minimum 140×60 px, 35×20 mm scan box, at least 100 DPI.
